void.string: <MainFocus> This guideline describes when and how clinic staff should clean their hands in order to reduce the spread of infection between patients.
<Users> Physicians, nurses and medical assistants working in outpatient clinics.
<Recommendation> Clinic staff should clean their hands with an alcohol-based hand rub before and after every patient contact.
<Directive> clean their hands with an alcohol-based hand rub before and after every patient contact
<Recommendation> If hands are visibly soiled, staff should wash them with soap and water for at least 20 seconds instead of using hand rub.
<Action> wash them with soap and water for at least 20 seconds
<Logic> If hands are visibly soiled is [true] Then wash them with soap and water for at least 20 seconds
